component.name: Linux.apk
component.summary: Run Android apps on the Linux desktop

description.p: Linux.apk runs Android apps as desktop apps: each app gets its own window, app-menu entry and icon, with sound, clipboard, notifications and file access through the desktop. Android itself runs rootless, in a sandboxed session of its own.
Open an APK file to install it, then launch the app from the app menu.
